annotations.title: Apply DNS records to several domains

description: Apply a DNS preset (list_dns_presets) or a saved template (tpl_…) to up to 100 domains at once; existing records are skipped. dry_run: true shows what each domain would get. Applies at once when you act for an owner or admin and the workspace lets agents apply changes.
name: apply_dns_to_domains
